reviews.title: Hate the app design
reviews.text: Love the idea. Hate the design. I’m self taught, playing off and on for about 15 years. I’m forced to play through the “basics” to move onto anything else. I scroll thru and like 30 lessons later it’s “learn Dm chord”. Like come on! I have to invest hours and hours numbing my skull just to try the app and see what other features you have? Ridiculous. 30$ just to see what your songs are like? Even then, I don’t know if paying for premium would unlock songs as the only tip I see is “finish the basics to try this”. Not sitting thru hours of beginner lessons just to try it out. Not blindly spending 30$ to try it. Maybe tailor it to more than just the newbie. App UI looks beautiful. Idea is solid. Tuner is awesome. What I described previously will cause me to never return.

reviews.title: The song options are terrible and they frequently remove songs that are popular
reviews.text: I would actually like to give this app three stars, but unfortunately, I cannot, the main reason that I cannot give this app three stars is because the majority of the songs in this app are terrible. I’m gonna go out on the limb and say that the average bass guitarist in 2026 doesn’t wanna play Beatles songs or classic music, there’s a severe lack of pop music and heavy metal, it seems that this app mostly caters to people ages 40 and maybe even older maybe even 50 and up. As a GenZ guitar and bass player who just recently got into playing music, I’d have to say this app this app is fun for like one month only. It’s a shame because I just paid over $100 for this app, they did not allow me to see the song selection before I purchased it, and well since I paid for the whole year in advance, there’s nothing I can really do. The app has not been updated since I bought it three months for bass guitar at least they constantly add music to the electric guitar, and piano and singing version of the app. I paid money for the bass version, and you have not added any songs in the several months that I’ve been playing except three, in fact this app has deleted more songs for bass guitar than it’s added. I would give this app a three out of 10 if you’re an electric guitar player. But if you’re a bass player, do not get this app unless you really like music like The Beatles and Billie Eilish. I’m also just gonna kind of go on a rant. If you buy this app to play bass know that you’ll get one

reviews.text: I had reached out with a ticket to support with no answer then requested a refund from Apple which they did but I still want to make a review so people know that this app is not all it's cracked up to be, and definitely not worth the money that they are charging for it. I had a lot of issues with notes being not registered in the app, even when I slowed the pace down to play at my own pace, the app was still not recognizing all of the notes even though I tuned my bass to the app in the built-in tuner within the app itself, and all of that registered just fine, but when it came to lessons, a lot of the notes were not being registered. I tried changing the phone out for another device, thinking maybe it was the microphone. I changed out the guitar, thinking maybe it was my guitar. I changed out the amplifier I was using because I thought maybe it was the amplifier, and when none of those things proved to be the problem, it was apparent that the app is just not picking up the note on the string that I am making which made it very difficult and very frustrating to complete lessons

reviews.title: Suspicious trial period
reviews.text: I recently gave Yousician a try and the app could be an enjoyable way to learn but please be careful with the free trial. I created my account through apple and began the trial in the app (gave me no choice). I decided a few days in that I didn’t like the guitar tutorials but I might try singing on a lower tier subscription. When I went to cancel, the app didn’t show up in my subscriptions despite all help guides suggesting that’s where it should be. So I deleted my account through their website, was told I wouldn’t be charged, and I also removed access through Apple ID. I was still charged. I’m not even sure how they have my credit card? I never provided it to them and the charge did not come from Apple.

Replaced with a bizarre mix of super niche music nobody has ever heard of.

reviews.text: This app was gifted to me at the start of last year on the premium plan and was an adequate app for a beginner. However, when the auto renewal date came around, I received no email or message that I would be charged for the next year. I had zero intention of renewing and not to receive a message before being billed for such a large amount of money is disgraceful especially when you can’t cancel via the app which can mislead you into thinking you may have already cancelled the subscription. Finally, upon trying to contact Yousician about this, I can’t find a phone number to speak to anyone and they have ignore my email so far. Therefore, I would not recommend Yousician or any apps ran by the same people.
